findings.title: Automated suite can pass while node mode and result versioning are broken
findings.criterion_ref: PKGV2-T10 — the suite must “positively prove PKGV2-T01 through PKGV2-T09,” including PKGV2-T05’s exact node IDs and PKGV2-T06’s per-node result/evidence roots.
findings.trigger: A scanning command’s `--node` value is changed to another node ID, or a node’s result write is moved back to the parent `results/` root.
findings.consequence: The advertised regression suite remains green even though the graph would scan the wrong ownership slice or reuse a forbidden historical result path. It therefore does not provide the required automated proof of T05 and T06.
findings.evidence: `tests/test_execution_package_v2.py` lines 257–266 only identify commands lacking `--node`; they never assert each N20–N50 command’s argument equals its owning node. Lines 269–272 delegate graph checks to `validate_plan_v2.py`. That validator’s lines 173–220 require only the presence of `--node`, `--graph`, and the package graph string, without checking the `--node` argument. Its lines 201–205 validate only the header `result_pattern`, not every node’s result/evidence writes. Direct in-memory mutations confirmed both gaps: changing N20’s scan argument to `N30_PREFLIGHT_EGRESS` produced `wrong_node_accepted True`, and changing N40’s result write to the parent `results/` root produced `parent_result_path_accepted True`.

observations: The package graph itself currently has the correct exact N20–N50 node arguments, package-v2 result/evidence paths, N20 egress ownership, N60-only complete-tree invocation, source-spec digest, and non-overlapping write sets.
`scan_node.py` resolves its default graph to the package-local graph and narrows the unmodified parent whole-tree reports by the graph-derived write set.

The requested pytest invocation could not start in this read-only QA environment because Python had no writable temporary directory; the plan validator and all three historical parent result validations did execute successfully.

The N00 prompt describes the approval schema as frozen by `rules.frozen_before_entry`, while that rule lists only the node-result schema. This does not alter N00’s actual write ownership and does not independently defeat a numbered criterion.
reasoning: Direct inspection and targeted execution confirmed T00–T09 in the current artifact. I declined to treat the read-only pytest environment failure or the N00 wording mismatch as findings. The surviving major defect is specifically T10: realistic graph regressions violating T05 or T06 are accepted by the validator and unobserved by the suite, so the required automated proof is incomplete.
